visualCharacteristics.structure: 3 tabs + nutrient rows + ingredients + dietary icons

contentPattern: 3 rows x 2 columns (label | content). Row 1 'Nutrition Facts': serving size / servings paragraphs, macro summary (Calories 210, Protein 3g, Total Carbohydrates 26g), nutrient lines as paragraphs or a list of 'Name | amount | %DV' and the %DV footnote paragraph. Row 2 'Ingredients': ingredient paragraph + 'Contains: Milk, Soy' paragraph. Row 3 'Dietary Info': icon images each followed by label (OU-D, GLUTEN FREE). No nested blocks inside tab cells.
